metadata.description: Phase-transition database for elemental systems.  For each element the ordered phase sequence (solid polymorphs → liquid → gas) is listed with cumulative enthalpies and entropies relative to the DFT ground state (H = 0, S = 0).  Only solid polymorphs with a known transition temperature (from literature) and an enthalpy (the Materials Project DFT energy, or an assessed value) are retained.  Liquid and gas phases are always included.
metadata.policy: GGA-anchored unary data policy (2026-10-23). Every DFT energy is the Materials Project GGA/GGA+U (PBE) thermo energy, the scale of the GGA convex hulls; no r2SCAN energy enters. Order of sources: MP-GGA sets the ground state and every phase it has; the omegas GGA file supplies BCC/FCC/HCP references MP-GGA lacks or places below the ground state; SGTE or an assessed literature value replaces a DFT enthalpy only where the observed 1 atm phase order needs it, or where no DFT BCC/FCC/HCP reference lands above the ground state; a CALPHAD assessment supplies a BCC/FCC/HCP end member none of these has. Tier A (spurious_structures.json) removes MP entries before ground-state selection: structures with no 1 atm stability field, and -- with category 'sgte_corrected' -- real phases whose ladder enthalpy is SGTE or assessed, so no corrected DFT entry reaches a hull. The anchor must be the expected 1 atm ground state ('expected_gs_spacegroup', the observed one or SGTE's stable element reference). Tier B emits per-element 'lattice_stabilities' for BCC/FCC/HCP prototypes not on the ladder and lists refused ones under 'excluded_lattice_stabilities'. Virtual polymorphs inject real phases Materials Project has no entry for. Six metastable HCP lattice stabilities carry SGTE's entropy instead of dS = 0 ('metastable_entropy_exception').

conventions.reference_state: The lowest MP GGA/GGA+U energy per atom after the Tier A blacklist defines H = 0, S = 0 for each element; it is the expected 1 atm ground-state spacegroup. Real low-T allotropes (Na and Li 9R, alpha-Sn, alpha-Ti) are the anchor where they are the 1 atm ground state.
conventions.sgte_corrected_phases: A real 1 atm phase whose DFT enthalpy breaks the observed phase order (below the ground state, or out of heating order), or that carries an existing assessed ladder value, takes its anchored SGTE or assessed literature enthalpy, cited in the phase's metadata. Its MP entry is Tier A blacklisted at its spacegroup with category 'sgte_corrected' and supplies only the structure identity: the ladder phase's materials_project_id is 'sgte-<El>-<spacegroup>' and metadata.corrected_mp_id names the replaced entry.
conventions.lattice_stabilities: Per-element block of cumulative BCC/FCC/HCP enthalpies above the anchor for prototypes (cI2, cF4, hP2) NOT on the phase ladder, with no transition temperature -- solid-solution end-member references only; they never enter the ladder, the liquid stacking, or the hull line compounds. A ladder phase covers a structure only with its spacegroup AND prototype, so dhcp or graphite in SG 194 does not cover HCP. Sources, in order, the first at or above -1 J/mol wins: the lowest-GGA-energy MP entry of the prototype (computational entries included), then the omegas file, both measured from the ground state's MP GGA energy (one PBE frame, no shared structure needed); then, only when a DFT source exists but lands below the ground state, SGTE's lattice stability at 298.15 K (materials_project_id 'sgte-<El>-<spacegroup>'); then, when none of these lands at or above the ground state, the enthalpy at 298.15 K of a CALPHAD assessment's fitted end member, without its entropy (materials_project_id 'assessed-<El>-<spacegroup>'; Hg BCC from the Hg-Tl assessment). An MP prototype entry below the ground state is Tier A blacklisted with 'ss_structure' and named in metadata.corrected_mp_id; metadata.rejected_sources lists the sources passed over. metadata.basis names the source; omegas_minus_mp_meV_per_atom records the cross-check where both exist. A structure with no accepted source is listed under 'excluded_lattice_stabilities' with its rejected sources. delta_S = 0 by the recalculation convention, EXCEPT for the entries listed under 'metastable_entropy_exception'.
conventions.metastable_entropy_exception: Scoped, explicitly-keyed departure from the recalculation convention. A metastable structure has no stability field, hence no transition temperature, hence delta_S = 0 by construction -- so its free energy stays pinned at its 0 K enthalpy while SGTE says it should climb (~2.1 kJ/mol at Tm for hcp-Au, which leaves spurious HCP solid-solution fields on fitted diagrams). For six HCP lattice stabilities -- Au -1.6, Li -0.7, Ba -1.3, Ca -0.7, Cu -0.2, Ag -0.3 J/(mol K) -- the ENTHALPY is unchanged (still DFT/omegas) and only the ENTROPY is imported, as SGTE's -b from the dG = a + b*T lattice stability, taken as a difference against the DFT anchor phase rather than an absolute SER offset. Every value is NEGATIVE, which is what makes the change safe: the endpoint melting reconstruction takes max((h_liq - dH_i) / (s_liq - dS_i)), and a negative delta_S only enlarges the denominator, so the reference can move further below the ground state but never overtake it. Rh HCP is deliberately EXCLUDED (GHCPRH = 3000 - 0.5*T gives delta_S = +0.5, positive) and keeps delta_S = 0. Per-entry provenance rides in each entry's metadata as 'entropy_source' / 'entropy_basis'; the scope is exactly the entries that carry an 'entropy_source'. Ladder phases are NOT affected: every thermodynamically stable phase keeps deriving its entropy as delta_H / T_trans.
conventions.virtual_polymorphs: A phase that is a genuine 1 atm equilibrium allotrope but has NO Materials Project entry of that spacegroup falls through Tier A (blacklist), Tier B (lattice stability) and Tier C (re-anchor) alike, and a transition temperature would have nothing to attach to. Such a phase is injected onto the ladder (materials_project_id 'virtual-<El>-<name>'), carrying a cited transition temperature and an ANCHORED SGTE or assessed enthalpy -- a difference against a phase shared by both frames (SGTE's zero is GHSER<EL>, this database's is the MP ground-state total energy), never a raw SER offset. NO ENTROPY IS IMPORTED: the injected phase is thermodynamically stable, so it keeps the delta_S = delta_H / T_trans convention like every other ladder phase. Injected phases: beta-Y (bcc, 1751 K, 4886.73 J/mol), beta-Sc (bcc, 1610 K, 4016.50), gamma-Sm (bcc, 1185 K, 3270) and gamma-Mn (fcc, 1361 K, 4348), alongside the pre-existing re-entrant delta-Fe (1667 K, 1737). Consequences: a real ladder phase SUPERSEDES the metastable lattice stability of the same spacegroup, so Y and Sc lose their BCC 'lattice_stabilities' entries (+11987.46 / +10161.50 J/mol, 2.5x the assessed transition enthalpy); Y, Sc and Sm gain a solid step, so their liquid H and S rise; gamma-Mn sits between beta- and delta-Mn, whose 6227 J/mol is cumulative alpha->beta->gamma->delta. Every injected phase is strictly bracketed in BOTH enthalpy and transition temperature by its ladder neighbours.
conventions.known_ground_state_conflicts: Declared (element, structure) pairs are those whose omegas-file energy is untrustworthy -- Mn HCP, where GGA magnetism ranks hcp ~3.1 kJ/mol BELOW alpha-Mn. No omegas-derived lattice stability is emitted for a declared pair, whatever its sign; an MP-GGA entry of the prototype still takes precedence.
conventions.cumulative_enthalpy: H(phase) = DFT enthalpy above GS for solid polymorphs; H(liquid) = H(last solid) + H_fusion; H(gas) = H(liquid) + H_vaporization.
conventions.cumulative_entropy: S is accumulated stepwise: at each transition i, ΔS_i = ΔH_i / T_i, where ΔH_i = H_i − H_{i−1} and T_i is the transition temperature.  S(phase) = Σ ΔS_j for all j ≤ i.
conventions.enthalpy_ordering_filter: Among all solid polymorphs with known transition temperatures, the largest subset maintaining strictly increasing enthalpy with increasing temperature is retained.  A longest-increasing-subsequence (LIS) algorithm selects the maximum number of phases; ties are broken by preferring earlier (lower-T) phases.
conventions.no_heat_capacity: No Cp integration is performed. Enthalpy is treated as a step function that changes only at phase transition temperatures.
conventions.null_values: null indicates data not available from the queried sources.
